items.title: Ed Garland Interview, 1957-04-16
items.q: David Jones playing alto, mellophone and sax.

ctx.x: There were nine. It's a pretty big band, huh?
Well, we had Jimmy Pallar played violin and tenor saxophone, and we had Jones playing mellophone and alto.

items.title: Ed Garland Interview, 1958-08-08; 1958-09-03
items.q: What happened after we got there, we had David Jones playing a mellophone.

ctx.x: In December weeks anyway. Almost. It wasn't a year though, I guess.
No, no, no. What happened after we got there, we had David Jones playing a mellophone.

items.title: Ed Garland Interview, 1971-04-20
items.q: We had David Jones with us too. He played mellophone and sax.

ctx.x: You know what I have to say? You bring this man to the end of the Southern Pacific line. They want to fire him. They want to send him back. He said, well, come me out too. We had David Jones with us too. He played mellophone and sax.
